name: Mitie Group plc
summary: Mitie Group plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides facilities management and professional services in the United Kingdom and internationally. It operates through the Business Services, Technical Services, and Corporate Centre segments. The company offers cleaning and hygiene, decarbonization, engineering maintenance, integrated facilities management, landscapes and grounds maintenance, projects, security and intelligence, waste and environmental management, managed water, guest services, and workplace solutions.
